summary: SFL Corp Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on October 5, 2026, announcing it agreed to build two 93,000 cbm Very Large Ammonia Carriers with dual-fuel propulsion and fuel-efficient technology, for delivery from Q2 2028. Aggregate yard construction cost is expected around $216 million. Concurrently, SFL secured long-term time charters to a European investment-grade oil major, adding a minimum of roughly $162 million to fixed-rate charter backlog, with initial charter duration to be set within six months and up to four years of charterer extension options. This is an ordinary newbuild/charter contract, not a special situation.
